instruction: Independently review the candidate. Similarity alone is not equivalence. Compare inputs, resource versions, effects and state predicates. Uncertainty must remain unpublished. Backward review receives only the private hierarchy; forward review receives only execution context. An active outcome sourced from an accepted execution is an observed state and a permitted action source. Unexecuted milestones are not observations or equivalent completed states. For retirement, distinct means the retirement is justified, otherwise return uncertain or reject.
